import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py');original=p.read_text()
cases=[
('漏掉竖向消除','((1, 0), (0, 1))','((1, 0),)'),
('只删除匹配的两个格','removed.update(cells)','removed.update(cells[:2])'),
('漏掉连锁消除','if not removed:\n            return board','if not removed or board != columns:\n            return board'),
('落下时颠倒余块','for x, col in enumerate(board)]','for x, col in enumerate(board)][::-1]'),
('仍保留非法局面','settled = stable_mayan_board(board)','settled = board'),
('放宽步数到4','assert 1 <= steps <= 3','assert 1 <= steps <= 4'),
('放宽单列高度','1 <= len(col) <= 8','1 <= len(col) <= 9'),
('合法字节也重写','if settled == board:','if False:'),
('忽略列末哨兵','col[-1] == 0','True')]
results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new in cases:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old))
  p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_mayan_initial_stabilization_against_independent_run_scanner','tests.test_gmyhf_review_fixes.ReviewRulesTests.test_mayan_legal_bytes_and_input_structure'],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode})
finally:p.write_text(original)
s=Path(__file__).read_text()
Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch11-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':11,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
